version: rffi_post_a/pilot_matrix v1 (2026-10-24), frozen before any R0 numeric output

recipe.secondary_checkpoint: native_best.pt (min receiver-equal native CE on fit-RX positions 120:160)
recipe.seed_rule: torch init seed = job seed; episode schedule seed = job seed + 1 (numpy only); identical for the three arms of a fold

evaluation.manifests: Stage A held-RX manifests (same sample IDs, 20 draws, budgets 0/1/2/5/10)

decision_rule.lowshot_mean: (acc_m1 + acc_m5)/2, draws averaged per RX, then RX-equal
decision_rule.representation_gain: P_RX/H1e - C_MATCH/H1e >= +2 pp lowshot_mean in both folds
decision_rule.per_budget: 1-shot and 5-shot deltas each >= 0 in both folds
decision_rule.rx_structure: P_RX/H1e - P_MIX/H1e >= +1 pp lowshot_mean in both folds
decision_rule.rx_consistency: >= 6 of 8 held RX with positive P_RX - C_MATCH lowshot_mean
decision_rule.risk: per fold worst-RX lowshot drop vs C_MATCH <= 3 pp; H0 0-shot mean drop <= 5 pp
decision_rule.competitiveness: per fold P_RX/H1e lowshot_mean >= best fixed secondary head of C_MATCH (fold mean)

prediction_basis: Stage A WiSig T0 2400 steps: 30.6-31.6 s loop, 36.1-38.7 s reserved; A3 WiSig evaluation 23.6-51.6 s reserved (reports/rffi_calibration/stage_A_execution). R0: 2x steps, same batch size, extra ProtoNet loss and probes -> predicted <= 300 s/fit incl. setup; 12 evaluations (6 fits x 2 checkpoints) <= 120 s each.
